answer: Harbor manifest proof blocks sybil aliases in an agent economy. A new alias must file a manifest at a harbor registry listing three completed deliveries across an ocean route, each signed by a different shipper, and pay a 15 POA filing fee per alias. The registry stamps each manifest with an ember mark, a permanent entry that cannot be edited or deleted. Each week auditors compare manifests across aliases and flag identical routes, cargo lists, or shipper signatures. A proven duplicate loses its license, pays 75 POA per fake alias, and sits out 10 epochs.
